controls.effect: Publish complete station-ready snapshot independently of voice readiness and auto-Available.

assertions: No ready on socket-open/Welcome alone. Register-time silentRelogin restoration publishes ready/initial-login once with current metadata even without a prior snapshot; ordinary-reconnect silentRelogin emits nothing new. [Jest evidence: MR-02/MR-06; T-007 cc.ts::noEarlyReady; T-011 cc.ts::socketOnlyNeverReady, cc.ts::firstStationLoginReady and cc.ts::registerRestoredSessionReady.]

Accepted switches and admitted primary closes clear serving placement before publication/callbacks; recovering and retry-wait snapshots, including the first 100-second wait before a new attempt, omit servingRegion/limitedService until a new primary Welcome. MR-06 consumes the MR-02 eligibility-changed hook to republish only changed metadata on an existing current-session snapshot, preserving status/reason and never creating ready/unavailable from settings alone. Omitted metadata clears old values; limitedService is present only with enabled eligibility and known home/serving regions. [Jest evidence: MR-03/MR-06; T-011 cc.ts::hydrationCompletionRepublishesHomeRegionAndLimitedService, cc.ts::hydrationRepublishesExistingSnapshotOnly, cc.ts::unknownMetadataClearsPriorValues and cc.ts::enabledOnlyLimitedService; services/core/websocket/WebSocketManager.ts::primaryPlacementAccessorAndReset and services/core/websocket/WebSocketManager.ts::rtdNeverRecordsPlacement.]

Ready does not claim Available, migrated ongoing-call audio or supported RTD success. [Jest evidence: MR-06/MR-07/MR-08; T-007 cc.ts::voiceDeferredReadyAndSingleDispatch; T-010 cc.ts::rtdFailureLeavesCoreReady; T-011 cc.ts::completeSnapshotEachAutoOutcome.]

End-of-session reset clears dedup/auto/initiating metadata so the next accepted identical ready/initial-login emits again. Teardown emits only a final complete cancelled snapshot when auto-state is pending, then resets after an ownership recheck; otherwise no region event. [Jest evidence: MR-02/MR-06/MR-07/MR-08; T-011 cc.ts::logoutThenReloginEmitsReadyAgain and cc.ts::teardownCancelsThenResetsSnapshot.]

Successful manual login from a DR stationLoginRequired outcome retains region-switch and initiating trackingId/operation/scope, omits autoAvailable/retryAfterMs and uses current placement metadata. [Jest evidence: MR-06; T-007/T-011 cc.ts::manualDrLoginReadyMetadata.]
